capabilities: draw handwriting on an infinite canvas
add text blocks and editable tables on the canvas
erase strokes with the S Pen barrel button
style text with colors, bold and backgrounds
export content as PNG or PDF and link PDF attachments
extras: README is written in German and consists mostly of detailed changelog entries; installation is manual (copy files into .obsidian/plugins). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Handschrift-Notizen auf einer unendlichen Leinwand wie in OneNote
problem: Obsidian has no freeform handwriting surface optimized for stylus input like OneNote's infinite ink canvas.

relations.evidence: Handschrift-Notizen auf einer unendlichen Leinwand wie in OneNote

summary: Handwriting plugin that lets Samsung S Pen users draw on an infinite canvas with text blocks, tables, an S-Pen eraser and PDF export.
